observations: Sewing machine on a tiled floor.
The text 'IDEAL TOPSTAR' and 'Super Automatik' is visible on the front panel.
An electric foot pedal and power cord are lying next to the machine.

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows an electric foot pedal and power cord, which indicates it is an electric model, not manual.

risks.risk: The motor or foot controller may be burnt out or non-functional.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine running when the pedal is pressed.

risks.risk: Internal mechanical timing may be off or gears may be jammed.
risks.proof: A video of the machine successfully sewing a line of stitches on fabric.

risks.risk: Essential internal parts like the bobbin case may be missing.
risks.proof: A photo of the bobbin compartment with the cover removed.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powered on and sewing through fabric.
Photo of the bobbin area showing the bobbin case is present.
Photo of the motor specifications plate usually found on the back or side.
response.reason: The item is clearly identified by brand and model. While its functional state is unknown and the seller's description of it being 'manual' is contradicted by the visible electric components, it can be priced at its worst-case value as a non-working unit for parts or repair.
